user.title: Connect a heating account
user.description: Choose the brand of the mobile app that is already linked to the heating system. Select **Bosch** for the Bosch app or **Buderus** for the Buderus app. The app brand matters more than the logo on the appliance.

auth.title: Sign in with SingleKey ID
auth.description:
SingleKey ID is the same sign-in used by your Bosch or Buderus app. Use the same email address or mobile number and password. You do not need a new account, and you do **not** enter your password in Home Assistant.

1. Keep this dialog open and open [SingleKey ID]({authorization_url}) in a new Chrome tab. Always use this newly generated link.
2. Press `F12` there and open **Console** in the developer tools.
3. Sign in with the SingleKey ID credentials used by your heating app.
4. A network-problem message may appear after sign-in. In this case it normally only means that Chrome could not open the `{redirect_scheme}://` app address.
5. Find the red **Failed to launch** or **Connecting to** message in the console. Right-click the blue `{redirect_scheme}://` address in that message and choose **Copy link address**.
6. Return to this dialog, paste the complete address below, and select **OK**. The field may display dots for security.

Use the address from this exact sign-in attempt and do not copy only the `code` parameter. The complete address contains a short-lived one-time code. Never share it in an issue, chat, screenshot, or log.

retry.title: Retry gateway discovery
retry.description: SingleKey ID sign-in succeeded, but the PointT service could not be reached. Check the Home Assistant internet connection, wait a moment, and select **Submit**. You do not need to sign in again.

gateways.title: Select gateways
gateways.description: Select every heating gateway that Home Assistant should use. Most homes have one gateway; in that case, select the only item. The final four characters help distinguish gateways with the same model name.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: The saved PointT authorization is no longer valid. Select **Submit** and repeat the SingleKey ID steps. Your existing gateway selection will be kept.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure and rediscover
reconfigure.description: Choose the app brand, gateways, and polling profile. Saving reloads the integration and performs a complete resource discovery. Use this after a firmware update or when circuits, hot water systems, heat sources, or gateways have changed. **Standard** reads current operating values every minute. **Cloud-friendly** reduces cloud traffic by reading them every two minutes and all other changing values less often. Changing the app brand requires a new SingleKey ID sign-in.

reconfigure_retry.title: Retry gateway discovery
reconfigure_retry.description: The current gateway list could not be loaded. Check the Home Assistant internet connection, wait a moment, and select **Submit**.

error.cannot_connect: The PointT service cannot be reached. Check the internet connection, wait a moment, and try again.
error.invalid_auth: SingleKey ID rejected or expired the authorization. Use the new SingleKey ID link shown above and repeat sign-in.
error.invalid_redirect: Home Assistant could not use this address. Copy the complete app address from the Chrome console's ‘Failed to launch’ message. It must begin with the scheme shown above and belong to the current sign-in attempt.
error.gateway_changed: The gateway list changed while this dialog was open. Close the dialog and open Reconfigure again.
error.select_gateway: Select at least one gateway from the list before continuing.
error.unknown: An unexpected PointT error occurred. Wait a moment and try again.

abort.already_configured: This heating account or at least one selected gateway is already configured in Home Assistant.
abort.invalid_flow: This setup session is incomplete or expired. Close the dialog and add Bosch/Buderus Heating again.
abort.no_gateways: No compatible gateway was found. Check that the selected brand and SingleKey ID account match the heating app and that the gateway is online.
abort.reauth_required: The saved authorization is no longer valid. Close this dialog and select Reauthenticate for Bosch/Buderus Heating.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The settings were saved. Bosch/Buderus Heating is reloading and discovering all available resources again.

init.title: Configure a holiday
init.description: Choose an existing holiday. Create, rename, move, or delete holidays in the **Holiday periods** calendar; use this dialog for the heating-system settings that the standard Home Assistant calendar cannot display.

holiday.title: Configure holiday
holiday.description: Change the PointT settings for **{holiday}**. Only options advertised by this heating system are shown. The integration writes once and reports success only after every field has been read back and confirmed.

error.holiday_changed: The selected holiday changed while this dialog was open. Close the dialog and try again.
error.write_authentication_failed: The cloud sign-in is no longer valid. Reauthenticate Bosch/Buderus Heating before trying again.
error.write_failed: The holiday settings could not be changed.
error.write_not_confirmed: The heating system did not confirm every holiday setting. No success was reported.
error.write_rate_limited: The PointT cloud is currently limiting requests. Wait before trying again.
error.write_validation_failed: At least one selection is no longer supported by the heating system. Close the dialog, refresh the integration, and try again.

abort.holiday_changed: The selected holiday is no longer available or writable.
abort.holiday_updated: The holiday settings were saved and confirmed by the heating system.
abort.no_writable_holidays: No writable holiday exists. Create one in the Holiday periods calendar first, or wait until the holiday resources are available.
abort.not_loaded: Bosch/Buderus Heating must be loaded before a holiday can be configured.

repeated_rate_limit.title: Bosch/Buderus cloud requests are being limited

confirm.title: Use cloud-friendly polling
confirm.description: Select **Submit** to switch this integration to the cloud-friendly polling profile. Current operating values will then be read every two minutes instead of every minute; control and energy values every ten minutes; slow counters every thirty minutes. The integration reloads and performs a complete resource discovery.

abort.entry_not_found: The affected Bosch/Buderus Heating entry no longer exists.

incompatible_firmware.title: PointT capabilities changed after a firmware update

confirm.title: Rediscover PointT capabilities
confirm.description: Bosch/Buderus Heating found {conflict_count} known capabilities whose data type or unit no longer matches the safely supported PointT schema. Select **Submit** to reload the integration and inspect all capabilities again. If the warning returns, download the integration diagnostics and report the changed schema without sharing credentials or raw values.

abort.entry_not_found: The affected Bosch/Buderus Heating entry no longer exists.

write_validation_failed.message: This setting is not currently safe to change. Refresh or reconfigure the integration and try again.

write_not_confirmed.message: The heating system did not confirm the new operating mode. Its previous displayed state has been retained.

write_authentication_failed.message: The cloud sign-in is no longer valid. Reauthenticate Bosch/Buderus Heating before trying again.

write_rate_limited.message: The PointT cloud is currently limiting requests. Wait before trying the change again.

write_failed.message: The operating mode could not be changed. No success was reported because the heating system did not confirm the value.

state.ch_dhw_frost: Heating, hot water and frost protection
